datasets.summary: Recomputed all 12 previously measured selected-author contexts against the current regenerated registered tables (numeric routes pass in all: Pearson .9751-.9935, Spearman .9642-.9871, 100% direction, coverage 99.22-100% of selected rows) and reconciled mouse eligibility with the published Methods rule (>=2 cells per sample). Astrocyte contexts (3) select identical mice and deposited nuclei; OPC, oligodendrocyte and Ghrh contexts (9) gain 1-3 low-count mice under the author rule, so their cohorts differ. Proposes three explicitly selected-scope astrocyte comparison specs plus cohort reviews; 16 unmatched contexts unchanged; no dataset-level pass.

manualReview.note: 2026-11-15 continuation: publisher Supplementary Data 1/4, GEO cell metadata and accepted manuscript re-retrieved with SHA-256 equal to the 2026-09-11 record. The registered DE tables were regenerated after 2026-09-11; recomputation against current tables reproduces the twelve selected measurements (Pearson .9751-.9935, Spearman .9642-.9871, 100% paired direction, selected-author coverage 99.22%-100%). The accepted-manuscript Methods require at least two cells per sample. Under that rule the three astrocyte contexts select the same 20 mice and deposited nuclei as the registered 20-nucleus rule (major.class equals author sub.class); OPC, oligodendrocyte and Ghrh contexts gain 1-3 low-count mice (for example OPC Arc23 with 5 and Arc30 with 3 nuclei), so their cohorts differ from the registered result. The 75 nuclei separating the paper total 75,787 from the deposited 75,862 are unidentified. All author rows are nominal P<.05 selections, not the tested universe. Sixteen of 28 registered contexts have no matching author coefficient. Evidence: continued-sources/GSE262407/turbo-2026-11-15-partial4/.

cohort.note: Astrocyte contexts: identical mice and deposited nuclei under the published two-cell rule. OPC, oligodendrocyte and Ghrh contexts: author rule admits 1-3 low-count mice excluded by the registered 20/10-nucleus rules. 75 primary-versus-deposited nuclei unidentified.

contrast.note: Publisher descriptions define glucose minus saline within diet and HFD minus control under saline, matching registered case minus baseline. hfd_vs_chow_glucose has no author table.

features.note: Exact symbol join; 0 duplicated author symbols; 6 unmatched selected rows across three non-astrocyte contexts; author code excludes ^Gm|Rik$ and Methods exclude genes in <=10% of cells.

effects.note: Both edgeR log2 fold change case minus baseline; Pearson .9751-.9935, Spearman .9642-.9871, 100% direction across the twelve selected contexts.

inference.note: Registered edgeR-QL two-arm fit versus author robust-dispersion glmLRT; FDR calls differ widely and are contextual.

coverage.note: 12 of 28 registered contexts have a selected author reference; selected rows omit the tested nonsignificant tail.

comparabilityReview.criteria: author-concordance-v2 per context within selected scope: >=30 paired genes, >=90% selected-row coverage, Pearson and Spearman >=0.90 or >=90% direction; cohort, contrast, identifier and effect compatibility required. Absent rows are not author negatives.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: Three astrocyte contexts meet every scoped criterion including cohort compatibility; nine contexts agree numerically but have a documented cohort difference; sixteen contexts unassessed. No dataset-level pass.
